_comment: PLB-1248. Verified directly against LawBase_Design's PICK_LIST on 2026-10-14 - these are
the only 3 'Efile%' picklist names that exist there today (Sandbox/the ECF4 cert-era
build has ~20; Design's simplified rebuild only ever seeded these three - see
HARNESS_SCOPE.md). TESTING_RULES.md rules 1-2 apply: a floor here only moves on real
evidence (a user-confirmed re-seed, a Tyler-side attorney-roster change), its own commit,
never bundled with a code fix.

picklists.sync_mechanism: TaxLit13PJSubmit.exe --sync-attorneys (PjTools.SyncAttorneysAsync) - MERGE upsert, never DELETEs a stale row, and already refuses to touch PICK_LIST at all if Tyler returns zero attorneys
picklists.why: Live Tyler firm-roster cache - row count legitimately drifts as attorneys join/leave the firm, so the floor is 'never empty' (the one thing the sync code itself can't protect against: a DELETE from outside the sync path), not an exact count.

picklists.sync_mechanism: none found - grepped every live exe in I:\E_file_local\BatchFiling\_tyler_net4_extract; LitFilingRunner.cs only ever SELECTs this list, nothing INSERTs/DELETEs it
picklists.why: No live code repopulates this list. If it is ever emptied (bulk edit, a future cleanup script, a bad migration), nothing will self-heal it - every Litigation existing-case judgment/dismissal/non-suit filing loses its FilingCode choice silently. Exact floor, not a 'never empty' floor.

picklists.sync_mechanism: none found - same grep as above, zero write references anywhere in the live exes
picklists.why: Same reasoning as EfileLitExFilingCode: hand-seeded, no refresh path, so a drop is permanent until a human notices. Every row also carries the literal pair ExtraInfo1='TylerDocumentTypeName'/ExtraInfo2='EfileLocationPk' (self-describing column-role tags, not per-row data) - verified uniform across all 99 rows 2026-10-14.

known_blank_extrainfo2_fee_codes.why: Pre-existing as of 2026-10-14, not introduced by this ticket. Recorded explicitly so a THIRD code going blank is caught as a regression, and so either of these two getting a fee value is noticed rather than silently accepted.
